description: SECURITY (s441, S440 F4). The Promise-returning stdlib function `verifyPassword` is stored in an object and called through it (`checks.password(pw, hash)`). The compiler inserts `await` only at call sites it can see, and a call through a property is not one: the check tests an unawaited Promise, always truthy — every password accepted. Ruled S440 (F4): storing an async-colored function in an object is a compile error.
rationale: §13.2: an async-colored function SHALL NOT be used as a value; storing it in an array or object SHALL be a compile error (E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE, §34). The rejected alternative — implicitly awaiting every call of a function-typed value — is named in the same ruling.
